parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket in the archive that reports this exact problem: a crash in the settings UI when you pick a font from the autocomplete popup while editing the font face field (here, selecting "Hack Nerd Font" from the suggestions and pressing Enter). The closest tickets are different. terminal#19751 is a crash when setting a Nerd Font (Maple Mono NF CN) in Settings, with a crash signature in Windows.UI.Xaml.dll. It was closed because the reporter could no longer reproduce it, and the maintainers mentioned a related fix in #19753. terminal#2114 is an old crash from a Nerd Font set in profiles.json. The others are font-not-found or rendering problems. Since your ticket mentions #20004, which isn't in the archive I was shown, I can't confirm it. In the meantime, you could try Terminal Canary to see whether the crash still happens. You could also avoid the popup by typing the full font name "Hack Nerd Font" yourself, or by editing settings.json directly. Please attach the crash details from Event Viewer (the faulting module and exception code) to the ticket so the team can compare it with the earlier XAML crash.
